scientific_integrity: The general proof is analytic and the finite integer verifier only corroborates its identities. The only novelty assessment is a same-model bibliographic comparison; no independent proof check or priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact polynomiality requires fixed integer surplus r and n >= r. The Mahonian leading correction is asymptotic for each fixed r >= 3; no uniformity in growing r, stochastic domination, or first-passage characterization is asserted. Potential earlier equivalent treatments in addition-chain literature require independent bibliographic checking.
title: Polynomial rare-left-tail counts for the Ulam–Kac adder and a universal Mahonian deficit
